comment:
* Log file wrapper class. Log messages into the message trace file and also write the log into * the debug file if needed. This class keeps an XML formatted trace around for later access via * RMI. The trace can be viewed with a trace viewer (see tools.traceviewerapp). * * @version 1.2 $Revision: 1.39 $ $Date: 2009/11/11 14:00:58 $ * * @author M. Ranganathan
* *

variables.name: logFileName
variables.comment: * Name of the log file in which the trace is written out (default is null)

variables.name: printWriter
variables.comment: * Print writer that is used to write out the log file.

variables.name: auxInfo
variables.comment: * Set auxililary information to log with this trace.

methods.name: public boolean needsLogging()
methods.comment:
* Global check for whether to log or not. To minimize the time return false here.
     *
     * @return true -- if logging is globally enabled and false otherwise.
     *

methods.name: public void setLogFileName(String name)
methods.comment:
* Set the log file name
     *
     * @param name is the name of the log file to set.

methods.name: public String getLogFileName()
methods.comment: * return the name of the log file.

     * @param from from header of the message to log into the log directory
     * @param to to header of the message to log into the log directory
     * @param status the status to log.
     * @param sender is the server the sender or receiver (true if sender).
     * @param time is the reception time.

methods.name: public void logMessage(SIPMessage message, String from, String to, String status, boolean sender)
methods.comment:
* Log a message into the log directory. Time stamp associated with the message is the current
     * time.
     *
     * @param message a SIPMessage to log
     * @param from from header of the message to log into the log directory
     * @param to to header of the message to log into the log directory
     * @param status the status to log.
     * @param sender is the server the sender or receiver (true if sender).

methods.name: public void setTraceLevel(int level)
methods.comment:
* Set the trace level for the stack. * * @param level -- the trace level to set. The following trace levels are supported: *
    *
  • 0 -- no tracing
    • * *
  • 16 -- trace messages only
    • * *
  • 32 Full tracing including debug messages.
    • * *

methods.name: public int getTraceLevel()
methods.comment:
* Get the trace level for the stack.
     *
     * @return the trace level

methods.comment:
* Set aux information. Auxiliary information may be associated with the log file. This is
     * useful for remote logs.
     *
     * @param auxInfo -- auxiliary information.
